settings.heading: Prepare your request
settings.text: Include these details so we can understand the scope of your recognition project.

settings.question: What should I include in a quote request?
settings.answer: Share the product or award type, quantity, recipient names and engraving text, budget range, needed date, and any purchasing requirements.

settings.question: Can awards recognize different names and service years?
settings.answer: Yes. Include the recipient list, names, service years, and engraving text in your request so the personalization can be discussed with the project details.

settings.question: Can we share purchasing requirements?
settings.answer: Yes. Include the requirements or documents with your request. We will review the project details and discuss the next step.

settings.question: How is the needed date handled?
settings.answer: Share the date the recognition gifts or awards are needed. Timing depends on the product, quantity, personalization details, and availability; the project schedule is discussed with the quote.
